# Expected exit status of each examples/*.fern binary, checked by
# scripts/ci-run-example from examples.yml and macos.yml.
#
# Both lanes used to run every example as `"./build/$name" || echo "(exited
# $?)"`, which swallowed the status entirely: a SIGSEGV, an abort, an arena
# exhaustion or a sanitizer finding printed one line and left the job green,
# so only compile-and-link was gated (#8473).
#
# A signal-range rule alone does not work here. Three of these examples
# legitimately return a computed value at or above 128 — factorial is 6! mod
# 256 — so "128+ means crashed" would fail the lane on correct programs. The
# table is what makes the check exact, and it is strictly stronger: it catches
# a wrong answer as well as a crash.
#
# Values are the program's own `main` result truncated to 8 bits, and are
# identical on x86-64 and arm64. To add an example, add its row; the gate in
# internal/sourcelint fails when one is missing rather than skipping it.
array 100
factorial 208
fizzbuzz 0
hello 0
iter_pipeline 148
regex_captures 219
sum_for 55
